description: This is a unit test class for the ImmutableSubject class, verifying its immutability, JSON serialization/deserialization, and correct behavior of its creation methods.

classes.name: ImmutableSubjectTest
classes.description: Unit test class for ImmutableSubject, verifying immutability, JSON serialization/deserialization, and correct construction of Subject instances.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Tests that ImmutableSubject instances are immutable and that dependent objects are also immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies the correctness of equals and hashCode methods for ImmutableSubject.

methods.name: testToAndFromJson
methods.description: Tests converting Subject objects to JSON and back, ensuring data consistency.

methods.name: createSubjectWithNullSubjectIssuer
methods.description: Checks that creating a Subject with a null issuer throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: createSubjectWithNullSubject
methods.description: Checks that creating a Subject with a null subject ID throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: createSubjectWithNullSubjectId
methods.description: Checks that creating a Subject with a null subject ID object throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: createSubjectWithNullSubjectType
methods.description: Checks that creating a Subject with a null subject type throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: createSubjectSuccess
methods.description: Tests successful creation of a Subject with a custom type.

methods.name: createSubjectWithUnknownTypeSuccess
methods.description: Tests creation of a Subject with an automatically assigned default type.

methods.name: createSubjectWithIssuerSuccess
methods.description: Tests creation of a Subject with specified issuer, ID, and type.

methods.name: subjectWithIssuerEqualsSubjectAndIssuer
methods.description: Verifies that Subjects created with issuer and without issuer are considered equal when other attributes are the same.
